headline: Systems-leaning generalist — strong fit for SWE-heavy roles, weaker fit for data roles
summary: Systems-oriented Computer Science and Engineering candidate with skills in programming, operating systems, computer networks, and object-oriented design. Built a distributed URL-shortening service, a multithreaded C++ job scheduler, and a Java parking-lot management system. Solved 350+ competitive programming problems and mentors juniors in DSA through the college coding club.
